main_body: 4x3 block of sci-fi metal panel tiles with rivets, a recessed hatch panel and a cyan light. It reads as terrain (floor or wall face), not a standing object.
top_band: Within each panel, a lighter blue-grey band sits on rows 1-8 with a darker lower face below. The scan at x=47 shows only thin 1-row highlight lines on a dark L=50 ground, so there is no standing top surface.
evidence: The kind is terrain, a repeating tile set rather than a standing volume, so the top-plus-front contract does not apply. Each panel has a lighter upper band, a step, and a darker lower half, and the hatch tile has an inset dark edge. No receding side faces and no object is mis-drawn as a flat elevation.

style.evidence: The candidate has 6 median colours per tile and 9 distinct colours. That is on par with the paving reference (7 and 7) but far below the grass (26 and 80). Flat-fill coverage is 0%, and the dark edges are tinted blue-slate (0% neutral), unlike the paving's 80% neutral edges. It uses roughly 5 steps (dark gap, mid, light, highlight, cyan accent), with rivets, scratch dashes and panel seams providing texture. It is not a sticker look and holds up beside the paving reference, though it is thinner than the grass.
